name: iScale Digital LED Bathroom Weighing Scale | Tempered Glass, Accurate & Automatic Weight Monitor
description:
Track your weight with accuracy and style using the iScale Digital LED Bathroom Scale. Built with a 4-sensor precision system, it provides consistent readings up to 180KG. Featuring tempered glass for durability, a bright LED display for visibility, and auto ON/OFF for convenience, this slim and modern scale is ideal for home, gym, or personal health monitoring. Cell-operated and safe with an anti-skid platform, it ensures reliable results every time.

Key Features
High-precision 4-sensor system for accurate measurement
Measures up to 180KG (397 lbs) with 1KG sensitivity
Dual unit display – easily switch between KG and LB
8MM toughened tempered glass platform, sleek and durable
Auto ON/OFF with step-on activation and low battery indicator
Anti-skid design for safety on smooth floors

Ingredients / Materials
Material: 8MM Tempered Crystal Glass
Display: LED digital screen
Power Source: Cell operated (battery included)

How to Use
Place the scale on a hard, flat surface (avoid carpets)
Step on to activate automatic measurement
Read weight on the LED display
Auto shut-off saves battery when not in use

Package Includes
1 × Digital Bathroom Weighing Scale
1 × Battery (Installed)
1 × User Manual
